title: Support that knows every account
description: Triage the queue, investigate hard cases in the product itself, and resolve with evidence. It's how we run Strawberry's own support.
introduction: A good support answer needs the helpdesk, the CRM, billing, the docs, and sometimes the product itself, as the customer sees it. That's five tabs before you've typed a word.
Strawberry checks all of them in the browser, drafts the reply, and keeps the evidence next to it. We run our own support this way, and we've written down exactly how.

items.title: Set up support like we do

blocks.text: Not sure where to start? Your companion can look at the work you have open and suggest the first thing worth handing over.

skill.context: Ask your companion to look at your work and suggest the first thing to hand over.

sections.title: Set up support the way we run it

blocks.text: Our own setup, step by step: connecting the tools, learning from resolved cases, setting the boundaries, and turning on Routines once the manual flow works. Copy it as closely as you like.

items.context: Walk through Strawberry's own support setup and adapt it to your team.

blocks.text: Strawberry reads every new case with its full history and prepares the right next step for each, so the morning starts with a plan instead of a pile.

sections.title: Crack the cases nobody can answer

blocks.text: It checks the account, billing, the docs, and past cases, and reproduces the problem in the product itself when it can.
Replies, refunds, and access changes go through once you approve them, and Strawberry checks that the change actually took effect.
Customer impact, a reproduction, and screenshots, packaged for the engineering team instead of "a customer says it's broken".

items: Update the help center from cases that keep coming back.
Review one account's health: usage, open issues, and renewal risk.
Escalate an issue to the right owner with the evidence they need.

blocks.text: Support knowledge usually lives in the heads of the two people who've been there longest. Save it as team skills and every companion answers the way they would.
Put queue triage on a Routine and every shift starts with the cases sorted and the next steps drafted.
